segments.title: Mod Hell & Lethal Company Setup
segments.notes: Case Blackwell struggles with green screen and mod compatibility (Late Company, Bigger Lobby, LC API, Bippin, Yippie, Spectate Enemies) while attempting to join Fiona's Lethal Company lobby; nephew Tracy Chapman joins; extensive troubleshooting of mod folders and Steam verification.

segments.title: Papito's Debut & First Quota Run
segments.notes: Pepito enters as 'Papito' dog mod character; Crum joins and dies to bees; team develops spray-paint door marking system; Rob Elvie makes brief appearance; Bracken and mine encounters; quota partially met despite heavy casualties.

segments.title: Mod Swap to More Company
segments.notes: Persistent desync/crash issues prompt full mod list overhaul: Bigger Lobby removed, More Company added; Case guides Casim through folder deletion and reinstall; test run confirms stability.

segments.title: Eclipse Moon & Spray-Paint Navigation
segments.notes: Team tackles Eclipse moon with crouch-walk stealth; Case buys spray paints, jetpack, lockpicks; yellow-dot wayfinding system refined; multiple beehives harvested; turret and Bracken gauntlets survived; teleporter used for interior mansion extraction.

segments.title: Final Quota Push & Dinner Break
segments.notes: Case hits flow state; V-type engines and hairbrushes recovered; dot system validated; massive quota haul sold; Case announces dinner break at ~7 PM local, plans to return with Kendelle for remaining hours.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: anchor. Hosts 12-hour Lethal Company marathon, manages mod loadouts for 30+ player lobby, develops spray-paint navigation meta.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Plays as 'Papito' dog mod, survives full sessions via sprint-and-freestyle strategy, freestyles rap over boombox.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: recurring. Joins mid-stream, dies repeatedly to bees and Brackens, provides gambling-addict commentary on survival odds.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: recurring. Referenced in chat as 'fake gamer'; Crum challenges him to 1v1 Lethal Company match.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Asleep during broadcast; Case plans to wake her for post-dinner session.

storylines.beat: No advancement this episode; tournament remains community-pledge vaporware.

lore_notes.fact: Plays Lethal Company as a dog mod named 'Papito' with unique sprint-and-rap survival meta; claims dog vision is black-and-white [49:24].
Nephew plays under handle 'Tracy Chapman' and joins lobby via right-click invite [15:46].
Befriends a 'black fellow in the catacombs' (shapeshifter player) who walks him toward exit before bees kill both [47:51].
Spray-paint door-marking system (yellow dots for exit path, red dots for dead ends) invented by Case and refined by shapeshifter [02:04:37].

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a 12-hour Lethal Company marathon — 'Fi's 12 Hour Cream Company' — wrangling a 30-player modded lobby through persistent desync crashes, a full mod-list overhaul, and multiple quota runs. Executive Producer Pepito debuts as 'Papito,' a dog-mod speedrunner who survives by sprinting into darkness while freestyling. Crum joins mid-stream, dies spectacularly to bees and Brackens, and challenges Munch to a 1v1 rematch. The crew invents a spray-paint navigation system to escape the facility labyrinths, harvests a record beehive haul, and clears a massive quota before Case breaks for dinner with plans to resume alongside Kendelle.
